items.html: Now, all of the last seven of the dots have the form of Yod, except for the first two dots, Kamatz and Patach, which are two Vavs and a Yod. The thing is that when we count all the Yods in these seven dots, they are thirteen Yods, which is 130 in Gematria, the same number as in the word Ayin [eye], indicating that the dots emerged from the Ayin, and Kamatz and Patach, which are Yod and two Vavs, remained. Their Gematria is twenty-two, implying the twenty-two letters from which the vessels of Nekudim were made.
